name: warm-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache goes cold, or keeps the cache warm while you're away, so your next prompt doesn't re-read the whole conversation uncached. Two chips under the prompt, /warm-compact and /keep-warm turn each on or off for a session.

minTokens.title: Smallest context to compact
minTokens.description: A conversation smaller than this many tokens is left alone: reading it uncached costs little.

keepWarmRenewals.title: Most cache renewals per pause
keepWarmRenewals.description: With keep warm on, how many times the cache is renewed while you are away before a compaction takes over (when warm compact is on). On an hour-long cache, 2 keeps it two hours.

leadSeconds.title: Seconds before the cache expires
leadSeconds.description: How long before the cache would go cold the compaction starts.
